title_zh: 启用图书馆打印额度并核对记录

scenario.label_zh: 启用打印额度并核对使用记录
scenario.goal_zh: 发现打印额度未启用，完成启用和一页测试后核对使用记录

context_zh: 读者在图书馆服务台处理打印额度问题。
author: author-phase09-c

sentences.speaker: Ellis
sentences.text: This is weird. My account shows five pounds of credit, but the printer says I have none.

sentences.speaker: Noor
sentences.text: The credit is there, but activation isn't complete. Did you open the confirmation message?

sentences.speaker: Ellis
sentences.text: No. I thought the credit would be ready as soon as I paid. The receipt seemed useless.

sentences.speaker: Noor
sentences.text: It contains an activation button. Open it while you're signed in, then try one page.

sentences.speaker: Ellis
sentences.text: That worked. The page has printed. Where can I check what it cost?

sentences.speaker: Noor
sentences.text: Open the usage tab. It lists each print job and the remaining credit.

sentences.speaker: Ellis
sentences.text: I can see the one-page job and the new balance now. Thanks.
